messages.subject: Re: OCCUPANCY Error in detectionHistory(recordTable)
parts:
For some reason DateTimeOriginal is different from all the other entries in that it is Day/Month/Year, not Month/Day/Year like all the others. This is why you get the error message.
Did you create the record table with camtrapR?

Suggestions: 
1) rerun recordTable, see if error persists. If so, share the faulty image here.
2) remove that entry from the record table, doing something like records[!is.na(records$difftime),]

I am also surprised that you get this error for an entry of species = "Game" when you ran detectionHistory with species = "Black-backed Jackal".
Does the screeshot show row 591?
